about: Every asset the game ships, and where it comes from. Kept true by tests/config/assets.test.ts: a file in src/assets or public that is not listed here fails the build, and so does a listed path that does not exist. Read with docs/ASSETS.md.

assets.what: Fredoka, variable, Latin subset: headings, buttons, island names
assets.madeWith: Bundled unmodified by Vite from src/styles/fonts.css

assets.what: Nunito, variable, Latin subset: running text
assets.madeWith: Bundled unmodified by Vite from src/styles/fonts.css

assets.what: Brand mark, seven world emblems, six player pictures

assets.madeWith: Rendered from the brand mark by scripts/generate-icons.mjs (npm run icons)

assets.what: Glim, the guide: one rigged drawing with six states; and the character sheet
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG, posed and moved with CSS

assets.what: Number Garden: apple, leaf, snail, acorn, bird, mouse, frog, and the friends things are given to; towers of blocks, frames of five and ten, numbered stones, stories of things that come and go, and a bell
The picture kit: 57 plain drawings of things (a sun, a sock, a hen), 15 drawn lower-case letters and the numerals 0 to 9

Each world's own drawings: Reading Cove's sound cards and word tiles; Memory Forest's scenes; Robot Ridge's robot and ground; Inventor Island's bridge, ramp, beam and tub; Explorer Harbor's 37 story pictures, its maps, flags, islands and boat; the Music Lab's chime bars, bird, drum and signs
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG. Explorer Harbor's maps are drawn from numbers written by its content generator

assets.what: The shapes every island is sculpted from, and what floats between the islands
assets.madeWith: Written in code on three.js geometry; no model files

assets.what: Academy Rock and the six world islands
assets.madeWith: Sculpted in code with the modelling kit

assets.what: The brush texture and the painted material
assets.madeWith: Generated on the device from seeded noise (128 × 128, three channels); no image file

assets.what: The water: shallows, foam, rings, shadows, glints
The islands, boats, rock and cloud as pictures: what the hub shows first and falls back to
assets.madeWith: Rendered from the island models by scripts/render-sprites.mjs (npm run art:sprites); encoded as WebP

assets.what: The picture's sea: a gradient matched to the 3D water, and a tile of wave marks
assets.madeWith: CSS, with a small SVG written inline

assets.what: Eleven interface sounds, and the Music Lab's instruments: chime bars, a pipe, a drum and a click
assets.madeWith: Synthesised on the device with the Web Audio API, each from two or three oscillators; no audio files, no samples and no recordings, so there is no source audio to license

assets.what: The voice: one short recording for every line a child hears, for single words, and for six sounds that are not speech (a drum, a bell, a shaker, a whistle, a bird, a clock)
assets.madeWith: Synthesised ahead of time by scripts/voice/make_voice.py with piper-tts 1.8.0 (a GPL-3.0 tool, used to make the files and not shipped) and the voice model en_US-kristin-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices (repository licence MIT; its model card says it was trained on public-domain LibriVox recordings). The six sounds are made by the same script from a few lines of arithmetic each. Encoded as MP3 by ffmpeg. Each spoken clip was checked by a speech recogniser (faster-whisper, small.en); src/voice/manifest.json records the result and whether a person has listened to it. No person has

assets.what: The content packs: every activity's challenges, written out in full, one file for each world; and the storybook they draw on
assets.madeWith: Written for this project: by hand, and from tables by the generators in scripts/content (npm run content)

assets.what: Web manifest, robots.txt, the note in public/assets
